name: hud_ui_cheat_code_dialog_scalar_deleting_destructor
description: HudUiCheatCodeDialog::ScalarDeletingDestructor runs the dialog destructor, conditionally frees this when bit 0 of flags is set, and returns this.
known_limits: The smoke covers the returned-self and no-delete flags=0 path. The flags bit-0 delete branch is source-reviewed against Binary Ninja and the standard scalar deleting destructor pattern.

functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x406e10 validates the destructor call, bit-0 conditional operator delete, and returned self pointer.
